notes.title: 1.0.3 Update
notes.notes:
Hi All 

Some new updates following feedback from the community:

[h1][b]First up PBEM[/b][/h1]

PBEM now has basic support in the game. Select the PBEM option and start and play the game as normal. Once your turn is complete the game will save the game out to your user directory. - \Korsun\PBEMSavedGame

Example
C:\Users\myusername\Korsun\PBEMSavedGame

In the PBEMSavedGame folder is a file called KorsunPBEM. This is the file you will need to send to your opponent.

[b]Do not change the name of the file.[/b]

Your opponent should then save this file to the same folder on their computer.
Again, do not change the name of the file. They can then load the game from the saved games options in the Game Menu. The saved game will clearly be labeled as Email game.

You can only have one file in the PBEMSavedGame at a time.

[h1][b]Other small fixes/changes[/b][/h1]

After viewing the strategic map you will be returned to the same position on the main map.

More detail have been added in the English manual regarding combat.
